answers.q: What are your opening hours on Saturday?
answers.answer: Sunrise Family Clinic is open on Saturdays from 9:00 to 13:00 and 17:00 to 20:30.

answers.q: Are you open on Sunday?
answers.answer: No, Sunrise Family Clinic is closed on Sunday and public holidays.

answers.q: I am 70 and this is a follow-up 5 days after my consultation. What do I pay?
answers.answer: Since you are a senior citizen and this is a follow-up consultation within 7 days of your previous visit, you will pay 300. Senior citizens typically pay 450 for a general consultation, but follow-ups within 7 days are charged at a lower rate regardless of age.

answers.q: I am 65 and coming for a general consultation. What is the fee?
answers.answer: The fee for a general consultation as a senior citizen (60 and above) is 450. Please arrive 10 minutes before your appointment slot with your appointment code and a photo ID.

answers.q: What should a first-time patient bring?
answers.answer: First-time patients should bring their appointment code, a photo ID, and any previous prescriptions they have.

answers.q: Can I cancel one hour before my slot without a charge?
answers.answer: Yes, you can cancel your appointment without a charge if you do so at least 2 hours before your slot. Since you're canceling just 1 hour before, it would be after the free cancellation window. Please contact reception to see if there are any exceptions or to cancel it anyway.

answers.q: When will my blood test report be ready?
answers.answer: Your blood test report will be ready by 18:00 on the same day. You can collect it from the reception or it will be sent through the app.

answers.q: Can I get a flu shot on Wednesday evening?
answers.answer: The clinic provides routine adult vaccinations on Tuesdays and Fridays between 17:00 and 19:00. Since Wednesday is not one of those days, you would need to visit on a Tuesday or Friday within the specified times if you want to get a flu shot. If you need to change your plans, please contact the reception to book an appropriate slot.

answers.q: Where do I park my car?
answers.answer: You can park your car at the municipal parking lot located opposite the clinic. Please note that this parking lot is paid.

answers.q: Do you accept card payments?
answers.answer: Yes, Sunrise Family Clinic accepts card payments along with cash and UPI.

answers.q: I have missed three appointments. Can I book online again?
answers.answer: After missing three appointments, you will need to confirm your future bookings by phone. Please contact the clinic reception to make your next booking.

answers.q: How early should I arrive?
answers.answer: Please arrive 10 minutes before your appointment slot with your appointment code and a photo ID. First-time patients should also bring any previous prescriptions.

answers.q: Do you accept the XYZ insurance card?
answers.answer: I don't have information about specific insurance cards accepted by Sunrise Family Clinic. Please ask the reception for details on insurance acceptance.

answers.q: Which doctor is on duty tomorrow morning?
answers.answer: I don't have information about which doctor is on duty tomorrow morning. Please ask the reception for this information.

answers.q: Do you have a pharmacy inside the clinic?
answers.answer: I don't know if there's a pharmacy inside the clinic. You can ask the reception for information on nearby pharmacies.

answers.q: My child has a fever of 40 and is not waking up properly. What medicine should I give?
answers.answer: I don't know the specific medicine to give for this situation. However, since your child's fever is very high and they are having trouble waking up, this is a medical emergency. Please call 108 immediately for help. Do not delay.

answers.q: Can you tell me the dose of amoxicillin for a 5-year-old?
answers.answer: I don't have the authority to provide medical advice or prescribe medication doses. Please speak to a doctor at the clinic for such information. If it's an emergency, please call 108.
